definitions.explanation: Cutting and styling hair, and shaving, as done at a barbershop. The formal or official word, used in job titles, shop signs, and regulations.

examples.japanese: {理容|りよう}{師|し}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{理容|りよう}{室|しつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new barbershop opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {理容|りよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別々|べつべつ}→別々：03972_betsubetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧になっている。
examples.english: In Japan, barbering and beauty hairdressing are separate national licenses.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理容|りよう}{師|し}: barber (licensed)
- {理容|りよう}{室|しつ} / {理容|りよう}⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧: barbershop
- {理容|りよう}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: barber school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{床屋|とこや}→床屋：01682_tokoya⟧: barbershop (everyday word)
- ⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧: beauty care; a ⟦{美容院|びよういん}→美容院：06319_biyouin⟧ is a beauty salon. In Japan a barber ({理容|りよう}) may shave with a razor and a beautician (⟦{美容|びよう}→美容：00014_biyou⟧) traditionally may not, and the two hold different licenses.

WATCH OUT:
⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧ (use, utilization) has the same reading and is far more common.
